clue.text: Pasta cook — Italy's eating a lot

explanation.definitionFit: Rigatoni is a kind of ribbed tube-shaped Italian pasta.

clue.text: Penchant of the French in anticipation

explanation.definitionFit: Red is a colloquial label for a communist, after the colour of the revolutionary flag.

parts.note: a hit is a success, as a hit show

explanation.surface: Solving one item well earns the solver a fresh clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A hint is a clue or suggestion pointing towards something.

clue.text: Vision indeed embraced by shapely figure

clue.text: To the French, Paris say, has the right, cheerful readiness

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore

clue.text: Dog with case of rabidity is mine

explanation.definitionFit: A colliery is a coal mine with its buildings.

explanation.definitionFit: Grace means favour or goodwill, as in being in someone's good graces.

clue.text: Scoff accepting head of state's direction

parts.note: broke means having no money
